text.g02: [excited] …Oh my! It's you! Well, well, have you been well?
text.g03: [excited] Grandpa! Grandpa! Phone call! It's our grandchild!
text.p01: [excited] Hello! It's Grandpa! You doing well?
text.g04: [excited] Hey, Grandpa! I was talking first!
text.p02: [gruffly] Oh, come on, just for a bit.
text.g05: [warmly] Honestly… All right, let's both listen, then.
text.g07a: [warmly] Good for you. That's our grandchild.
text.g07b: [worried] Oh my! That won't do! Eat your vegetables too.
text.p03: [gruffly] Is it cold over there? Here, it's been snowing since this morning.
text.p04a: [gruffly] I see, I see. Don't catch a cold.
text.p04b: [excited] Is that so! Heh heh… [chuckles] then I've got something good for you.
text.g08: [warmly] Oh yes, the package we sent the other day — has it arrived?
text.g09: [warmly] Oh, was that the doorbell? I bet that's it. Go and get it.
text.g10: [warmly] Open it. The one on top is a scarf Grandma knitted.
text.g11: [warmly] Put it on? …Well? Nice and warm, isn't it?
text.g12: [giggles] Hee hee, I'm so glad. Worth knitting it late into the night.
text.p05: [excited] Look at mine too! The blue box, the blue box!
text.p06: [gruffly] Grandpa made a snowman out of our snow and sent it to you.
text.g13: [warmly] Oh, Grandpa. It's bound to have melted.
text.p07: [excited] It hasn't! I sent it refrigerated!
text.p08: [gruffly] Go on, hold it to your cheek.
text.g21: [exasperated] Oh, Grandpa! What's the use of chilling them? …There's a hand warmer at the bottom of the box too. [warmly] Hold it to your left cheek.
text.p17: [grumbling] Hmph, Grandma always gets the best part… [excited] Here, put the snowman on the left too! It won't lose to a hand warmer!
text.g22: [giggles] Hee hee, warm and cold, both at once.
text.g14: [warmly] Now, hold the phone back to your ear, okay?
text.p10: [softly] …So, are you coming home for New Year's?
text.g15a: [excited] Really!? Grandpa, did you hear? They're coming home!
text.g15b: [warmly] That's fine, that's fine. You're busy. We're always waiting for you.
text.g16: [warmly] We'll keep the kotatsu warm for you.
text.p12: [gruffly] Take care of yourself, you hear?
text.g17: [softly] …Well then, we'd better hang up. Okay, bye-bye.
text.g19: [giggles] Hee hee, no way. You hang up first, dear?
text.g20: [softly] Grandma loves you too, so much.
text.p16: [softly] …Grandma, which one do I press to hang up?
